explication: H3 is a C geospatial indexing library that maps latitude/longitude to hierarchical hexagonal cell indexes and supports operations on those cells. The documented command-line workflow converts a location to a cell, then reports its boundary or center; the library also covers neighborhoods, hierarchy, polygon filling, and geometry. The tree and excerpts show the core indexing, grid, and geometry modules, plus a website explorer. Some CLI and library implementation details were not sampled, so their connections are documented at the product level rather than inferred from filenames.
